title: The Limitations of Generative AI: What these systems cannot (yet) do, and why
description: A lay-readable, citation-verified survey of what generative AI systems systematically cannot do, organized by failure mechanism rather than as a list: statistical failures (confabulation, context, calibration), dynamical failures (learning while acting), and normative failures (obligations the system cannot represent). Beyond the models themselves, it examines the hosted-service delivery model and its research and digital-sovereignty costs, and the incentive structure behind vendor performance claims. Every citation was verified against DBLP, the arXiv API, and Crossref by a rerunnable script; open-access copies of cited papers are archived with cryptographic hashes.
